title: pohlana langsdorffii
intro: Pohlana langsdorffii, commonly known as Hovenia dulcis or Renga in Japanese, is a flowering plant native to East Asia, particularly in China, Japan, and Korea. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pohlana langsdorffii include its ability to stimulate liver function, improve digestion, and serve as a natural diuretic. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
